title: Automatic Renewal
plainEnglish: The contract may renew on its own unless you cancel in time.
counterClause: Renewal should require explicit written consent from both parties.
negotiationTip: Ask for a reminder notice before any automatic renewal.

title: Unilateral Changes
plainEnglish: The other party can change the terms without your agreement.
counterClause: Any changes must be agreed to in writing by both parties.
negotiationTip: Require advance written notice for any term changes.

title: Limitation of Liability
plainEnglish: The other party limits or removes their responsibility if something goes wrong.
counterClause: Liability should cover direct damages caused by negligence.
negotiationTip: Push for mutual and reasonable liability terms.

title: Broad Termination Rights
plainEnglish: The other party can end the agreement whenever they want.
counterClause: Termination should require reasonable written notice.
negotiationTip: Ask for a fixed notice period before termination.
